stem:
A choir director made a histogram showing the ages of the members of the choir.

Ages of Choir Members
instruction: Which statement about the data in the histogram must be true?

options.label: A
options.text: More than half the members are from 46 to 73 years old.

options.label: B
options.text: There are more men than women in the choir.

options.label: C
options.text: The choir has a total of 100 members.

options.label: D
options.text: Exactly 20 members are less than 32 years old.

visual_elements: Histogram with x-axis labeled 'Age (years)' with intervals 18–24, 25–31, 32–38, 39–45, 46–52, 53–59, 60–66, 67–73
y-axis labeled 'Number of Members' from 0 to 50 in increments of 5
